body.x: Nautilus Investment is running a global corporate collaboration program in New York from Oct. 13 to Oct. 18, 2026, to support Korean companies entering the U.S. market. The program includes a cross-border forum and investor relations (IR) sessions, local workshops, the Small Business Expo, KOOM Stage, KOOM Haus and networking events. Participating companies will present their technologies and products to buyers, investors and other stakeholders in New York while exploring opportunities for partnerships, investment and market entry. Nautilus Investment, a U.S.-affiliated venture capital firm based in Songdo, Incheon, was founded in 2019 and also operates global corporate collaboration programs connecting startups with technology companies such as NVIDIA, Microsoft and ANSYS.
A shopper who asks a brand's chatbot a question often gets a correct answer that sounds like it came from nowhere, with no sense of the brand behind it and no memory of the last visit.
Giving the agent the brand's knowledge, personality and a record of the relationship is the idea behind upfall's work.

upfall Co., Ltd., founded in 2022 and led by co-CEOs Soyoung Lee and Yerim Lee, develops emotion-aware AI agents. Its brand-dedicated service, Soul by voidX, connects a brand's products, policies and content with customer interests, with e-commerce as the initial core market. It supports the shopper from product discovery and inquiries to recommendations and return visits.

Three technologies underpin it. An ontology organizes brand information and customer needs into a relationship graph, emotion inference estimates emotional changes from the conversation, and RQ (Relationship Quotient), upfall's proprietary metric, tracks the depth of the relationship across interactions. Using information customers share with consent, Soul is designed to carry context into later conversations. It keeps to the brand's facts and commitments while adapting how it speaks to each customer's situation.

Soul reads product information, brand stories and policies from a brand's website URL and configures an agent that reflects the brand's personality and tone of voice. It has three roles. The In-house Agent manages brand knowledge and tracks brand visibility in AI-generated answers. The Customer Agent talks with visitors on the brand's site and guides them through products and content. The Ad Agent discloses that it is advertising and starts on-site conversations only within the scope of user consent. Brand news, content and events are woven into the conversation, giving shoppers a reason to engage with a brand beyond a purchase.

The company says it has carried out at least 50 AI projects across five industries over four years. In an in-house AI agent proof of concept for a major Korean company, its own measurements showed response time for complex knowledge queries falling from six minutes to 50 seconds. It built an AI learning agent based on educational content for the Korea Management Association and runs agents for inquiries and appointment booking at five medical institutions. upfall was selected for NVIDIA N&up 2026, signed an MOU with Alibaba Cloud in 2024, and was chosen by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to take part in Eureka Park at CES 2027, where it is preparing a Soul demo and 3D character agents.

The United States and Japan are its main target markets. In the United States, upfall is working to secure its first paid contract with an e-commerce brand, and in Japan it is exploring follow-on opportunities based on its semiconductor process simulation experience. It is looking for local brands that want to improve customer experience, e-commerce platform builders and operators, and businesses able to run joint pilots.

upfall plans to combine monthly subscriptions with customized enterprise deployments and to compare purchase conversion, return visits and repeat purchases between groups with and without the agent in controlled tests. The results will inform product improvements and the business model, and performance-linked fees remain under consideration pending the validation results. Over the longer term, it plans to extend its emotion inference, memory and relationship management into entertainment and other industries through 3D character agents that express conversational context through facial expressions, voice and reactions. Buyer matching, overseas pilot funding and multilingual localization are the support it wants most.
